doc: The pack's project: context sources over the small tree in test/support/pack/tree/, which Noetic.Harness.Pack links into each test's root. Its files are .exs where they would be .ex, because test/support/ is compiled. No integration is on, and there is no layout: a test that needs either writes a project of its own.
